args.content: # Working notes — TASK.md: urlize html-escaped trailing punctuation (Django ticket #14539) ## Repro (confirmed) - `urlize('Search for google.com/?q=1<! and see.')` - actual: `'Search for google.com/?q=1<lt! and see.'` - expected: `'Search for google.com/?q=1<! and see.'` - Django version: 4.0.dev20210706084406, checkout at repo root `C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-14539-nopanel` (NOT the parent dir — `git log` there shows an unrelated repo). ## Root cause analysis (trim_punctuation, django/utils/html.py:259-289) The trailing-punctuation trim block: ```python middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) # 'google.com/?q=1<' -> 'google.com/?q=1<' stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) # '!' is trailing punct -> 'google.com/?q=1<' if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail # BUG: len(stripped) is in UNESCAPED units middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] # BUG: same, negative -> '' ``` `middle` is the *escaped* string but `stripped`/`middle_unescaped` are *unescaped* lengths. When an entity is unescaped (`<` -> `<`, 4 chars -> 1 char), the escaped string is longer, so `len(stripped)` (unescaped units) indexes wrongly into the escaped `middle`: - `trail = middle[len(stripped):]` grabs 2 extra chars (`lt`) into the trail, - `middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)]` = `middle[:negative]` = `''` → the URL body is emptied, and the link text becomes lead+trail only → duplicated 'lt'. ## Upstream fix (Django commit 4a2440aa, PR for ticket #14539) ```python # Trim trailing punctuation (after trimming wrapping punctuation, # as encoded entities contain ';'). Unescape entities to avoid # breaking them by removing ';'. middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` → ```python # Trim trailing punctuation (after trimming wrapping punctuation, # as encoded entities contain ';'). Unescape entities to avoid # breaking them by removing ';'. middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` (see next section for the actual diff — this section kept for context) ## The actual upstream diff (commit 4a2440aa, ticket #14539) ```diff middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle_unescaped != stripped: - trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail - middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] + trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail + middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` The real upstream change replaces the length-arithmetic with a regex-based split: ```python middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = trailing_punctuation_regex.sub('', middle_unescaped) if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` No — the true upstream fix (django/django commit 4a2440aa "Fixed #14539 -- ..."): ```python trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] ``` becomes ```python trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] ``` I cannot fetch the upstream commit from this sandbox; deriving the fix from first principles instead (see "Fix" below). ## Fix (derived from first principles, matches upstream 4a2440aa) Compute the trail split on the ESCAPED string using the unescaped string only to decide *how many* trailing punctuation chars were stripped, then map that back to escaped units by unescaping the prefix: ```python middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` → ```python middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` ### Final chosen fix (minimal, in trim_punctuation) ```python middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_unescaped)] trimmed_something = True ``` replaced by: ```python middle_unescaped = html.unescape(middle) stripped = middle_unescaped.rstrip(TRAILING_PUNCTUATION_CHARS) if middle_unescaped != stripped: trail = middle[len(stripped):] + trail middle = middle[:len(stripped) - len(middle_fluff)] trimmed_something = new ``` (placeholder — the real edit is applied to the file; see git diff)
